args.rationale:
Per buyer instruction, the unconfirmed corporate bulk order of ~500 units is excluded, and purchasing is focused solely on meeting standard baseline forecast demand. 

Current usable stock is 600 units with no open orders. Forecast demand is 60 units/day over the 28-day planning horizon (1,680 units total). Without a purchase, stock will run out on 2026-09-27, resulting in 1,080 units of unmet demand. 

Creating a purchase order for 1,300 units from SUP-A at $9.00 per unit ($11,700.00 total) with expected receipt on 2026-09-22 fully satisfies baseline demand (0 unmet units) and leaves 220 units in closing inventory (3.7 days of cover, within the 12-day maximum cover policy limit and meeting the 200-unit safety stock target). The plan is feasible within the $30,000.00 available budget and storage capacity limits. Total spend exceeds the $2,000.00 buyer autonomy limit, so buyer approval is required.
